entities.name: Alliances
entities.description: The eighth Magic expansion, released June 1996 as the second set of the Ice Age block, whose story shows civilizations adjusting to the end of the Ice Age and allying against Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who builds an army of undead bent on world domination after the Ice Age ends.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who cast her World Spell, ending the Ice Age; character is a planeswalker.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: The spell Freyalise cast to end the Ice Age.

entities.name: The Ice Age
entities.description: A long cold age ended by Freyalise's World Spell, after which populations had to adjust to warm weather.

entities.name: Alliance against Lim-Dûl
entities.description: An alliance formed between races to defeat Lim-Dûl and his undead army.

events.summary: Freyalise casts her World Spell, ending the Ice Age and forcing a cold-adapted population to adjust to warm weather.
events.quote: After the planeswalker Freyalise cast her World Spell , thereby ending the Ice Age

events.summary: The new climate brings floods and plagues, and the necromancer Lim-Dûl builds an undead army bent on world domination.
events.quote: the necromancer Lim-Dûl has built an army of undead bent on world domination

events.summary: The races form an alliance to defeat Lim-Dûl and his army.
events.quote: An alliance is formed between races to defeat Lim-Dûl and his army.

relations.note: Freyalise cast it to end the Ice Age.
relations.quote: After the planeswalker Freyalise cast her World Spell , thereby ending the Ice Age

relations.note: The alliance is formed to defeat him and his army.
